name: qc-corporate-tax-co17
description: Prepare a Quebec CO-17 corporate-income-tax workpaper alongside the separate federal T2. Establish permanent establishments and allocation, Quebec taxable income, paid-hours and primary/manufacturing SBD eligibility, associated-group limits, C3i property and regional rates, legacy research versus CRIC transition, meals limits, instalments, filing, payment and representation. Calendar 2026 estimates are separated from actual 2025-2026 filing-cycle forms and the announced SBD change for years beginning after 29 April 2026. Unread law and special regimes are held explicitly rather than defaulted to a larger tax.
